purpose: The scenes of ROADMAP M3 criterion 1, by role. Each role names the candidate in use; changing one 'use' field swaps a model everywhere a role is read. Since the author's decision of 2026-10-10 ("No test models, only full owned assets.") every candidate is an asset raw-native generates itself; the material gallery's spheres are built in code (raw/renderer/gallery.hpp) and need no file.

source.verification: each file's SHA-256 equals the hash here; test_owned_assets checks the generator against evidence/m3-assets.json on every compiler
